# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root. The task skills are in
`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (Copilot CLI discovers them there; in
other Copilot surfaces, read the relevant file before starting). Before
answering a question about a modeled domain, read `.recall-latest.md`
(written by the prompt hook in `.github/hooks/recall.json`) and run
`python search.py` as AGENTS.md describes.
